colors.accent_note: Pack labels carry a single thin colour line per product (e.g. green on Niacinamide, pink on Salicylic). Backgrounds stay white/off-white/black/studio grey; the accent may echo the product's own line colour at low saturation.

pack_shot_light: Website pack shots: soft key light from upper left, shadow falling to the lower right on a light studio grey (#E5E9EA) sweep. Match this in generated scenes.
banned_imagery: fruit or food used as an ingredient claim the product doesn't contain
source: Observed: beminimalist.co pack shots and site palette (2026-10-03). To be refined with the Instagram house-style capture (brand_packs/minimalist/raw/instagram.md) when it lands.
